fr_html: LORD PHILLIMORE ayant constaté l'accord existant sur cet article, et le PRESIDENT ayant déclaré que la question du domicile des juges sera discutée plus tard, l'article est adopté sans discussion.
en_html: LORD PHILLIMORE stated that the members of the Committee were in agreement concerning this Article, and the PRESIDENT said that the question of the domicile of judges would be discussed later; the Article was thereupon adopted without discussion.
